description: This file contains database utility functions for initializing, connecting, executing SQL commands, and seeding sample data for a travel planner backend project. It manages SQLite database schema creation, connection handling, and data seeding tailored for user, trip, itinerary, destinations, bookings, and sharing-related tables.

methods.name: str _utc_now_iso()
methods.description: Returns current UTC time in ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: Path _data_dir()
methods.description: Determines the data directory path within the project workspace, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: str _db_path()
methods.description: Constructs the full path for the SQLite database file.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection get_conn()
methods.description: Establishes and returns a SQLite connection with row factory set for dict-like access.

methods.name: sqlite3.Cursor _exec(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Tuple[Any, ...] = ())
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with parameters on a given connection, returning the cursor.

methods.name: None init_db()
methods.description: Creates the database schema with tables for users, trips, itinerary, destinations, bookings, and shares if they do not exist.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] seed_sample_data()
methods.description: Seeds the database with a demo user, sample trip, and itinerary items, or retrieves existing data if present.

methods.name: str random_token(prefix: str = "tok")
methods.description: Generates a secure random token with an optional prefix.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] row_to_dict(row: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: Converts a sqlite3.Row object to a dictionary.

methods.name: list[Dict[str,Any]] rows_to_dicts(rows: Iterable[sqlite3.Row])
methods.description: Converts an iterable of sqlite3.Row objects to a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: int parse_bool_int(value: Any)
methods.description: Converts a boolean-like value into an integer (1 or 0).

methods.name: Optional[str] require_env(name: str)
methods.description: Fetches an environment variable value, returning None if not set.

ctags.name: _exec
ctags.pattern: /^def _exec(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()) -> sqlite3.Cursor:$/
